newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Rain slows DNS harvest.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Rain slows DNS harvest.

text.p: Spotty showers slowed progress of the dark northern spring wheat harvest in Montana, North Dakota and Minnesota, grain dealers there said.
"It's just been so slow," a Montana dealer said. "We were just getting started again (on the spring wheat harvest) when the rains came through."
Bids for dark northern spring wheat were mostly lower as MGE futures slipped. But some locations quoted higher values in hopes of enticing a few sales.
"We've got a train we need to fill," one dealer said. "We weren't buying anything so we pushed our bids up a bit."

Durum bids surged higher in Minnesota amid quality concerns, a merchandiser said. Excessive moisture during the growing season led to scab infestation and early cuttings were showing low test weights, the dealer said.
